usedFor: Shopify starts the work with “New Product”, and Affinda receives a document through “Upload a Document for Parsing”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Upload a Document for Parsing” in Affinda
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can push a document into Affinda for parsing, so reading starts without anyone uploading it.

watchOut: “Document Validation Completed” in Affinda is polling, so anything built on it runs after a short scheduled delay.
